title: 第一卷 第25章 争夺至宝第一卷 第26章 突破神力境
content_zh:
“不好！”
这一刹那，叶寒心神激荡。
他感觉到窒息的压力迎面而来，那是一道怎样的目光。
傲睨一世，目空一切！
面容威严之中带着冷漠与无情，如传说中高高在上的绝世天帝，盖世无双，主宰乾坤。
仿佛天地之间一切的生灵，一切的存在，都不被其放在心上……。
轮回之子，风无量！
一个令人窒息的名字，一个让书院中的长老都为之忌惮，不敢招惹的存在。
惊鸿一瞥，叶寒便已经内心激荡，意志溃散，有一种顶礼膜拜，直接匍匐在对方面前的冲动。
咯吱咯吱……！
叶寒骨骼裂响，死死握紧拳头。
就在万分之一个刹那，叶寒体内那一块神骨开始震动，蔓延出一股清流，让叶寒摆脱了那种心灵上的压迫感。
万古不败龙体，万古无敌，永恒不败！
这神骨的力量，深深影响着叶寒，让他的内心澄明，对那一道目光的忌惮消失得无影无踪。
好在，叶寒没有暴露。
那一道面容未曾有进一步表示，连同那虚影在随后便彻底淡化、溃散、消失……。
前方大地中，随着玄阴青王蟒死去，罗天征松一口气，急忙吞下数枚丹药，盘坐大地中开始了恢复。
一边恢复，罗天征一边开口：“师妹，以免变故，你直接收取兽核！”
“好！”
叶芷萱无比期待。

九阶妖兽王的兽核，价值非凡，尤其是对她如今的天蛟战骨可产生巨大的好处。
“看到它的眼睛了没？”
罗天征开口：“右眼下方，十寸至三十寸之间，便是兽核所在。”
“还有，它的本命精血，存在于胸前第二片鳞甲内部大约三十寸之间。”
罗天征补充道。
叶芷萱闻言，手中立刻出现一柄短刃，几步来到了玄阴青王蟒的头颅前方，忍耐着无形的恐惧，叶芷萱手中短刃刺出。
大约五十个呼吸后，一枚拳头大小的青色晶体被叶芷萱挖掘出来。
青色晶体一出现，叶芷萱的双目变得无比炽热。
同时，躲在暗中的叶寒眼瞳一缩，迸发出璀璨的光芒。
即便相隔甚远，这一刻的叶寒都感觉到一种无法形容的牵引感出现，那青色晶体，似乎引动了自己体内的那一块神骨。
叶寒甚至有种直接奔驰而出，将那兽核争夺到手的冲动。
九阶兽核，好东西！
这玩意儿若论价值，至少是几十万枚元气丹往上，而且没有人那么傻会将这种宝物换取元气丹。
content_en:
"Not good!"
At this moment, Ye Han's heart was agitated.
He felt the suffocating pressure coming towards him, and what a look that was.
Arrogant and arrogant, arrogant and arrogant!
His majestic face was filled with indifference and ruthlessness, just like the legendary supreme emperor of heaven, unparalleled in the world and dominating the universe.
It was as if all the creatures and existences between heaven and earth were not taken into consideration by him...
The son of reincarnation, Feng Buliang!
A suffocating name, a being that even the elders in the academy are afraid of and dare not provoke.
With a startling glance, Ye Han's heart was already agitated, his will collapsed, and he had the urge to worship him and kneel directly in front of him.
Creak, creak, creak...!
Ye Han's bones cracked and he clenched his fists tightly.
At just a ten thousandth of an instant, the sacred bone in Ye Han's body began to vibrate, and a clear current spread out, allowing Ye Han to get rid of the feeling of mental oppression.
Invincible dragon body, eternally invincible, eternally undefeated!
The power of this divine bone deeply affected Ye Han, making his heart clear and his fear of that gaze disappearing without a trace.
Fortunately, Ye Han was not exposed.
There was no further expression from that face, and then the shadow completely faded, disintegrated, and disappeared...
In the ground ahead, as the Xuanyin Green King Python died, Luo Tianzheng breathed a sigh of relief, hurriedly swallowed several pills, sat cross-legged on the ground and began to recover.
While recovering, Luo Tianzheng said: "Junior sister, to avoid accidents, just collect the beast core!"
"Okay!"
Ye Zhixuan is looking forward to it.
The beast core of the ninth-level monster king is of extraordinary value, especially for her current Heavenly Dragon Battle Bones, which can bring huge benefits.
"Did you see its eyes?"
Luo Tianzheng said: "Below the right eye, between ten and thirty inches, is where the beast's core is."
"Also, its natal essence and blood exist within about thirty inches of the second scale on the chest."
Luo Tianzheng added.
When Ye Zhixuan heard the words, a short blade immediately appeared in her hand, and she took a few steps to the front of the Xuanyin Qingwang python's head. Enduring the invisible fear, Ye Zhixuan stabbed out the short blade in her hand.
After about fifty breaths, a cyan crystal the size of a fist was dug out by Ye Zhixuan.
As soon as the cyan crystal appeared, Ye Zhixuan's eyes became extremely hot.
At the same time, Ye Han's eyes, which were hiding in the darkness, shrank and burst out with bright light.
Even though they were far apart, Ye Han felt an indescribable pulling feeling at this moment. The cyan crystal seemed to attract the sacred bone in his body.
Ye Han even had the urge to run out and grab the beast core.
Ninth-level beast core, good stuff!
In terms of value, this thing is worth at least hundreds of thousands of Vitality Pills, and no one is so stupid as to exchange such a treasure for Vitality Pills.
